scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @smartpark/api" "npm run dev -w @smartpark/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @smartpark/shared && npm run build -w @smartpark/api && npm run build -w @smartpark/web && npm run build -w @smartpark/iot
scripts.test: npm run test -w @smartpark/shared && npm run test -w @smartpark/api && npm run test -w @smartpark/iot
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @smartpark/shared && npm run typecheck -w @smartpark/api && npm run typecheck -w @smartpark/web && npm run typecheck -w @smartpark/iot
